name: Takejou Subaru
source:
The protagonist of the story. Once he wished to enter a medical university, but right now he is just a simple lolicon pervert. Just the thought of a little girl can make him excited.

With the Saotome family moving next door, he becomes a tutor and makes an oath to himself "to fully educate those girls".

The protagonist of the story. Once he wished to enter a medical university, but right now he is just a simple lolicon pervert. Just the thought of a little girl can make him excited.

With the Saotome family moving next door, he becomes a tutor and makes an oath to himself "to fully educate those girls".
